reviews.comment: Dr.Moore is very passionate about the subject of this class and her lectures are very good, she is very informative and a great professor. Be prepared for tests to be most of the grade but if you study there should be no issue. Definitely recommend.

Unfortunately this professor has been the worst one I have encountered at Texas A&M. It is sad to know there is a professor here that continually calls their students names, speaks sarcastically in a negative way, berates her students, and is not open to feedback. She is extremely close-minded as well as emotional and irrational.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is an eye-opener. It talks about problems that aren't discussed nearly enough in the world and is truly an intriguing class. Instead of spending hours reading a textbook, you get to watch TED talks, documentaries, read articles, etc. Dr. Moore elaborates A LOT but you can easily condense the information. Quizzes: easy online open note.

Very few grades in this class which consist of 3 quizzes, a test, and a couple of assignments. Her lectures are disorganized and she asks questions about the lectures on the quizzes. She only had one lecture per week that she cancelled often for various reasons. She drops your lowest quiz grade and has some extra credit which might save your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All quizzes and exams (basically only grades) were off lectures, or zoom calls if you want to call them that. Not recorded so pay attention. Drops one quiz grade. Cancelled class often. Not a difficult course, but if you screw up, there is no saving your grade except for the quiz drop. Wouldn't take again if I had choice, but not awful either.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You will have a lot of work in this class. All your quizzes are based on documentaries, podcasts, teen vogue articles, and chapters of books. To make a good grade on the exams, you have to do all the work and think like the prof. All she cares about is statistics. 2 projects, 1 zoom class a week. would not recommend honestly.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my easy classes but not super easy! Have to watch like 2 hour videos outside of her lecture. Only had class once a week. For exams literally write down any important definitions and any statistics that are in the lecture/videos that she may say. Either than that easy class, Good luck!!

Dr. Moore is very knowledgeable and kind. However, her lectures are very disorganized and the class is taught in a backwards format. Be careful when disagreeing with her, especially if your political views do not align with hers. Ask plenty of questions because assignment instructions are very unclear and lectures are hard to follow.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Moore is kind and considerate. Her lectures are informative and relevant. Almost no homework. 205 doesn't require much work to get an A, just take good notes. Come to class because she often gets frustrated at the lack of attendance and gives extra credit. A solid choice for 205 if you do the work. I don't recommend disagreeing with her though.

I liked her, but there were a lot of readings and sometimes it was difficult to know what I was supposed to know for the quizzes. Regardless, she makes a decent effort to make sure everyone is learning on track. Interaction in zoom meetings is not necessary, frankly they could be skipped since lectures are posted online (flipped classroom).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Professor Moore! She is very insightful on all lectures that she covers. You can tell that she genuinely cares about what teaches and is very knowledgeable as well. Very compassionate, understanding and wants us to grow in our learning experiences. If you show up to class and do the work quizzes are fine. Lowest one is dropped!

A LOT of these negative reviews are from people who are just MAD that Dr. Moore has opinions based off of FACTS. She still encourages debates from ALL view points and does a great job of maintaining neutrality. Easy class, lovely lectures, has office hours, and is a kind genuine person.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is an amazing professor, if you attend lectures and do the homework modules the quizzes are easy to answer! The other reviews who are stating negative comments or "you can tell her political belief" are close minded as she kept her stance neutral throughout the class and brought actual FACTS and not close minded opinions and assumptions.

This was supposed to be a Tuesday/Thursday class, but Dr. Moore only wanted to meet once a week. In that class once a week, it was just a discussion based on her lecture videos posted on YouTube that she wanted us to watch, which were filmed for a past semester. She was not easily reachable and not professional. (I took this Fall 2021).

She was a good professor, I enjoyed her classes, yes, there was a lot of reading but I think her exams or quizzes were not proctored, only taken on canvas (this was in fall 2020). It was an easy class and she was very nice and knowledgeable, there was a lot of discussions but it was interesting overall, good prof, this class is fine!

Dr. Moore is a nice lady. However, she is VERY disorganized and never responds to emails. So if you don't attend her online "discussion" classes, then there is absolutely no way to reach her. Classes are fully discussion based, and a bunch of articles and lecture material are posted online to do at your own pace. Easy A.

Overall a good course option if you are needing some kind of elective. Dr. Moore fosters good conversations that allow students to think for themselves. 5 Quizzes, 2 assignments, and a final make up the course. Overall if you do your work it is a fairly easy class.

I'm conflicted on Dr. Moore. Some days she was great, other days I couldn't stand her. For the papers, as long as you put in effort you will get a good grade. The tests, though, were not so easy. There were some tricky questions. I think she tries to be unbiased, but you can definitely tell where she stands on the class material.
I would not want to retake this class with her. It was very lecture heavy and was difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Moore!!!! Her hand-picked material is so interesting and meaningful. This is the first class I have ever felt truly changed afterwards and I am so grateful for her. 100% take this course with Dr. Moore if you can!

She was great!! Definitely take her if you have the opportunity. The class was easy to follow and you just have to make sure you do the weekly discussion and watch/read all the material, some weeks theres a lot of material but its manejable! Quizzes open note and the zoom was a good class discussion!Shes caring and could not recommend her enough

Dr. Moore is a very funny lady. She is very understanding and does her best to help students out. There is a lot of material to read, but the quizzes are open note which helps. She drops the lowest quiz grade, only requires 10/14 discussion posts, and is a very easy grader. She is somewhat unorganized and takes a while to respond to emails.
5 Quizzes, each 25 problems with 45 mins; Final Exam cumulative Quizzes and Final are open note No homework, aside from prior lectures and readings for quizzes Amazing Teacher

Dr. Moore is passionate about sociology. The class has lots of outside class work, lots of readings some almost 45 pages long, long videos most are over an hour, and much more. Discussion questions due every week, 5 quizzes,2 projects, and only one exam. Zoom lectures not always necessary, she basically just goes over the material in modules.
I loved Wendy Moore! Her courses are really interesting. I would love going to her class and would definitely take her again if she offered another course! I took her 317 and 205 course.

Moore really cares about whether or not her students learn the material. Easy A, attendance is mandatory, all exams online. After the COVID situation, she made remaining assignments extra credit, so you didn't have to do any more work if you were happy with your grade at the time. Have an open mind in this class. Some took her jokes too seriously.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Standard sociology class. This semester the class was slightly hybrid w/ video assignments to watch in place of class some days with an assignment over it. Offered some extra credit. After online classes, gave us a grade and told us we could either accept it or do two assignments to improve our grade, she's super understanding!!

I'm going to give this a fair and ubiased rating. It is not a super hard class and that's about the only redeeming factor, apart from that it's very unorganized. As a result of cancelling class often, multiple podcasts were assigned which is what the final was based on. Would have much rather preferred normal lectures to take notes on.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is SO UNORGANIZED!! This is fairly an easy class and gives you points for just showing up to call. 2 tests online, pretty easy. She was one of the worst professors No one cared about the class or took it seriously. Very disappointing because it is interesting material. The class would have been better if she came prepared.

Moore is hands down the worst professor Ive had at tamu. She assigned a ridiculous amount of work to justify cancelling class. Changed the syllabus 3 times, no one ever knew what was going on bc she was so disorganized. Changed the requirements for a paper after people had already turned it in and they had to start over. Save yourself the headache
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Funny and caring professor. Reading the book does help. Would cancel class and assign videos or movie to watch instead. Quizzes over the videos but they're short and easy. 4 quizzes act as your exams but they're open note online and act as great study tools for the final. Take her!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is absolutely hilarious. She is very real with her students but is also very professional. She had a lot of days where you had to watch movies instead of go to lecture (along with a quiz). 4 online quizes and a final. Super easy.

Moore was a good professor over all. She made her lectures funny and likes when people participate. Her class is not hard and is actually enjoyable. There are online quizzes that are not hard and a couple video quizzes. The only thing is that if you voice your opinion in class and she doesn't agree, she will make it known.
Really good teacher and fairly easy class, only thing is the teacher is very liberal. Overall is a good class, with some online quizzes, few video assignments, and one final.

Dr. Moore was a hilarious teacher and in the class, you have 4 quizzes and 1 final. you can find all the quizzes on quizlet and she drops the lowest score and the final is literally all the quizzes mashed together. I enjoyed her lectures honestly all in all she was a solid teacher.

I loved Dr. Moore. She did give very liberal opinions in class, but she still made sure to articulate her views and gave evidence to support and some counter evidence. That being said, class was cancelled often which goes from amazing to crap when you are on campus. Two online open book exams, and one final that is the two exams put together. EasyA

Dr. Moore is very unorganized. I probably went to class a total of 6 times the whole semester due to cancellations. Even though the quizzes she gives are very simple and can be found online, the course itself with her teaching was dreadful. She doesnt reply to emails and she expresses her very liberal views to the whole class.

Dr. Moore is a cool lady, and her class is very easy, but I actually hated going to it. Every class always ended up just being her preaching her extremely liberal views on many different topics. She gives four online quizzes, video quizzes for when she doesn't hold lecture, and an in class final. Not a hard class if you put a little effort into it.

This class is fairly easy and doesn't require much work (4 online quizzes, and in-class final), but its not worth it! Lecture is basically Dr. Moore preaching on her biased liberal views. She asks for participation but gets mad if anyone counters her opinion. I didn't learn anything worthwhile all semester and left almost every class annoyed.

Dr. Moore is a hilarious professor. Makes lecture fun but still teaches at same time. Lots of video assignments throughout the semester that are in place of class. 4 online quizzes, drops the lowest score. One cumulative final exam in class. She does give quizzes over the videos. Overall a great class, would definitely take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She was a good professor, but you have to work for it by showing up to class, watching the assigned movies, and reading the book. Your effort in this class will determine the grade. Super funny and keeps things interesting.

Good  professor. She grades fairly. Make sure you take detailed notes. She does have some health issues , so a lot of times she is not at her office hours. That's not her fault, so I don't blame it on her. It was a great class overall. I learned a lot. I recommend this class. Although she does not count attendance, you will NOT pass if you skip .

You definitely need to come to class and take good detailed notes. Read all of the books and know specific facts! The tests are online and you get to use your books and notes. Dr. Moore knows a lot and wants you to do well. Just don't slack off or get behind on readingwatching videos.

TAKE HER CLASS. I am so, SO glad that I took this class with her, it was amazing. She is the best professor that I've ever had. There are reading assignments that lead up to a open note test that you just have to be detailed on but she gives us the material in the lectures too. I LOVED going to this class, never missed it.
don't take this class if you are a historian.  she gets a bit preachy and likes to throw out personal opinions as historical fact.

She's very passionate and EXTREMELY smart! She has a law degree from one of the top 20 Law Schools!  She doesn't post notes so you HAVE to go to class! She does take home exams that require your class notes and textbook readings. She's awesome!
Refers to herself as Ghetto, and doesn't realize how offensive that is!!!!
Great prof, takes a legal approach which gives a great societal perspective of how embedded social inequality becomes in our institutions. Amazingly knowledgeable about subject area.
nice lady, but sometimes the lectures are boring. Read the book and use the online website to study for your quizzes. not a hard class at all if you read the book.
